dedupeResult: Exact-name, canonical-domain and published-contact checks against the accessible repository index plus the current and recent seed/report artifacts returned no prior canonical Madox Records, Cosmic Fairy Records or UNS Records submission record. GitHub rejected a full pull-request diff because the pull request exceeds the 300-file diff limit, so canonical SQLite domain, normalized-URL and contact deduplication remains required before external use. Each opportunity is stored once; Madox's form and authorized demo mailbox are consolidated, Cosmic Fairy's protected contact is not decoded, and UNS's general mailbox is excluded as a demo route.
emailVerificationLevel: Madox first-party publishes demo@madoxrecords.com for demos and info@madoxrecords.com for business; both are syntactically valid and domain-aligned, and only the demo mailbox is authorized for music. Cosmic Fairy exposes a protected contact link whose mailbox was not decoded or guessed. UNS first-party publishes contact@unsrcrds.com as a syntactically valid, domain-aligned general contact, not an explicit demo inbox. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.
formVerificationLevel: Madox uses a first-party form requiring name, email, genre and SoundCloud URL, with optional notes, and also publishes an authorized demo mailbox. Cosmic Fairy uses a first-party unreleased-music form preferring private SoundCloud playlists or Dropbox and requesting contact, country, Instagram and prior-label-submission information. UNS uses a first-party form requiring artist name, email, genre, track link and artistic-context message. No field, link, consent, email, payment or submit action was exercised.
safety: No email was sent, no form field was filled, no private music link was shared, no audio file was attached or uploaded, no privacy statement, terms or agreement was accepted, no protected contact was decoded, no CAPTCHA, hidden anti-spam or submit-time control was tested, no payment was made and no submission, authentication or platform restriction was bypassed.
